scope: Puerto Rico USACE water-related report/project corpus
producer_rules: AguaYLuz owns the raw USACE source manifestations, immutable bytes, hashes, family expansion and water-domain bindings.
Raw strings are preserved; normalized discovery keys cannot overwrite raw values.
Every download receives a retrieval receipt and SHA256.
Different hashes prove byte difference only.
A source-family filename is not proof that the bytes contain only that logical appendix.
Source arithmetic must close for every certified snapshot.
thehub_rules: TheHub stores discovery, provenance and certification state only.
TheHub must not become the raw-document authority or silently rewrite producer identity.
Promotion is blocked if any declared source or manifestation remains unexplained.
spiderweb_rules: Spiderweb may consume validated canonical waterbody/project geometry only.
Document search hits, nearest features and text aliases are discovery only.
